source: CRX-dependent developing-retina CRE (enhancer/silencer) MPRA reporter activity (Friedman/Cohen, Cell Systems 2024 DOI 10.1016/j.cels.2024.12.004; barakcohenlab/CRX-Active-Learning Data/activity_summary_stats_and_metadata.txt); 每元件 sequence(164bp)+ expression_log2 (barcode-averaged MPRA reporter activity, log2)+ original_seq(种子谱系 5330 families)+ library(9 generator 批次); single-mechanism=CRX-driven transcriptional activation/silencing in developing mouse neural retina
cannot_claim: composition confound: GC/motif-composition 本身驱动 CRE activity → baseline 必含 mono/dinuc composition; 测 higher-order 结构 beyond composition
